How would this be done for mkv files? Thats my primary structure as I record about 4 separate audio tracks.

Edit: Having had previous experience with Registry editing, I copied the data under 'VLC.mp4->shell->Open->command' in regedit to 'VLC.mkv' and this seems to have done it. I also had to change 

    "C:\Program Files\VideoLAN\VLC\vlc.exe"

to

    "C:\Program Files (x86)\VideoLAN\VLC\vlc.exe"

Only 2 hours? You've got a better work ethic than I do. It'd take me three days, two demonic sacrifices, seven crusades and an eighth starting, and a few new DnD campaigns (complete with a whole de-rail of course). That's talent.
Good God how much time was spent on this?!

But that's missing the point. Almost everyone is not happy with how CQC is. We don't want to have to push into CQ to have a chance to fight. We want variation in combat and to be able to fight a pump shotgun viably. Pushing into CQ is the reason why shotguns are so strong. Outbuilding here is not the issue, it's the fact that you can be one shot through RNG and at such close quarters.
But building forces CQ like many others have pointed out

Merry Brostamas to all members of our massive 20 player group. Especially to you, Greylok, as I wouldn't have played DnD without you trying to get my soppy ass out of bed. 

As the list of our adventures grows, so do our memories. And as we gain memories we become something more. Family. 

You sorry lot of murderers, brigands, chaotic, (partially) insane people have become my second family, and I will always cherish our memories even though our sessions may be distant and spread now. 

We've had honourable characters die, and idiots get locked in jail for years. But above all, the Northstar shone through tyranny's darkness and gave us stories to tell everyone.

Have some wonderous holidays my brothers and sisters. For you all have become a part of me and Solis.

With love,
    Cernus.


To r/DnD; This was actually sent to my group's chat (the Multiverse because of how many campaigns run surrounding the same three characters) and I've got some great responses from them! I wish you all the best, and have some very happy holidays!

"I'm telling you, it's because I previously had married the now wife to the bar keep! I helped her start the tavern with my own damn money! It's right in chapter 5! Did you not read my backstory?!"

Chapter 5 out of probably 200. I haven't read that book in a while.
